founder.lead: Founder and operator of Lucky Domains. A CPA and PMP with roughly two decades in finance, product, and program leadership, and about 20 years working with websites.
bio: Ken started his career in accounting and financial reporting before moving into project, product, and program leadership. Over roughly two decades, that career ran through S&P Global, EY, Noom, and Prudential Financial, where he served as Director of Project and Product Management.

He has also worked with HTML, CSS, websites, and WordPress for about 20 years. More recently, he has increasingly used AI-assisted development to build websites and applications, including this site and KenAshe.ai.
He built Lucky Domains alongside that career and still runs it himself. The person on your first call is the person who values the domain, scopes the site, runs the audit, and writes the report.
experience: Roughly two decades across accounting, financial reporting, and project, product, and program leadership at S&P Global, EY, Noom, and Prudential Financial.
About 20 years working with HTML, CSS, websites, and WordPress. Ken built and runs LuckyDomains.io and KenAshe.ai himself, including the structured data and the automated tests behind them.

More recently, Ken has used AI-assisted development to build websites and applications, and he documents what worked and what failed on KenAshe.ai. One of those systems, the Autonomous SEO Agent, researches listing sites and builds profiles every day without supervision.
twoSites: The commercial business: website design and development, SEO, AI visibility, digital identity, brand authority, and domains, for clients.
